RunSynchronousCommand.Path: powershell.exe -WindowStyle "Normal" -ExecutionPolicy "Bypass" -NoProfile -File "C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\OEMAudit.ps1"

Extensions.File: # Runs once on the first audit mode logon. # Puts a launcher in the all-users Startup folder so OEMUpdate.ps1 runs at every audit logon until done, # and starts it right away. conhost.exe forces the classic console instead of Windows Terminal. # OEMUpdate.ps1 uses a mutex, so a double start is harmless. $startup = 'C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\StartUp\OEMUpdate.cmd' Set-Content -Path $startup -Encoding Ascii -Value '@start "" conhost.exe powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\OEMUpdate.ps1"' Start-Process -FilePath 'conhost.exe' -ArgumentList 'powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\OEMUpdate.ps1"' # Hidden helper that closes the Sysprep window at every audit logon (until "Finish Setup"). $conhost = "$env:WINDIR\System32\conhost.exe" $hideArgs = '--headless powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\OEMHideSysprep.ps1"' $ws = New-Object -ComObject WScript.Shell $lnk = $ws.CreateShortcut('C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\StartUp\OEMHideSysprep.lnk') $lnk.TargetPath = $conhost $lnk.Arguments = $hideArgs $lnk.WindowStyle = 7 $lnk.Save() Start-Process -FilePath $conhost -ArgumentList $hideArgs

@echo off if /i not "%~1"=="--conhost" ( start "" conhost.exe cmd.exe /c ""%~f0" --conhost" exit /b ) title Finish Setup color 07 mode con: cols=100 lines=40 >nul 2>&1 net session >nul 2>&1 || (call :header "Error" & echo Run this as administrator. & pause & exit /b 1)
call :header "Step 1/3: Checks" if exist "C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\StartUp\OEMUpdate.cmd" ( echo !! Windows Update loop has not finished. echo. ) echo Checking activation and devices... powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\OEMFinishChecks.ps1" set "PROBLEMS=%ERRORLEVEL%" if exist "C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\StartUp\OEMUpdate.cmd" set "PROBLEMS=1" echo. if "%PROBLEMS%"=="0" ( echo All checks passed. echo. pause ) else ( choice /m " Problems found above. Continue anyway" if errorlevel 2 exit /b 1 )
call :header "Step 2/3: Device encryption" echo Allow device encryption (BitLocker)? echo. echo Y = Windows encrypts the disk when the customer signs in with echo a Microsoft account. The recovery key is saved to their account. echo N = stays off. The customer can turn it on later in Settings. echo. choice /c YN /m " Allow device encryption" if errorlevel 2 ( set "BITLOCKER=off" ) else ( set "BITLOCKER=allowed" )
call :header "Step 3/3: Finish" echo Device encryption : %BITLOCKER% echo. echo This removes the setup files, the shop Wi-Fi profile and audit mode, echo then restarts into the normal Windows welcome screen so the echo customer creates their own account. echo. choice /m " Finish setup now" if errorlevel 2 exit /b 1
echo. echo ^>^> Cleaning up... if "%BITLOCKER%"=="allowed" reg delete "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\BitLocker" /v PreventDeviceEncryption /f >nul 2>&1 taskkill /fi "WINDOWTITLE eq Windows Update - do not close*" /f >nul 2>&1 del /f /q "C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\StartUp\OEMUpdate.cmd" >nul 2>&1 netsh wlan delete profile name="Tietoleppa" >nul 2>&1 del /f /q "C:\Windows\Panther\unattend.xml" "C:\Windows\Panther\unattend-original.xml" "C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\OEMWifi.xml" "C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\OEMUpdatePass.txt" "C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\OEMUpdateConfirm.txt" "C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\OEMUpdateStart.txt" >nul 2>&1 if exist "C:\Windows\Panther\unattend.xml" (echo ERROR: could not delete unattend.xml, aborting to avoid an audit mode loop. & pause & exit /b 1) reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\OOBE" /v BypassNRO /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f >nul echo ^>^> Starting Sysprep, the PC restarts in a moment... del /f /q "C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\StartUp\OEMHideSysprep.lnk" >nul 2>&1 echo stop> "C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\OEMFinishing.flag" timeout /t 3 /nobreak >nul taskkill /im sysprep.exe /f >nul 2>&1 start "" "%WINDIR%\System32\Sysprep\sysprep.exe" /oobe /reboot (goto) 2>nul & del "%~f0"
